enchantments.tooltip: Resistance +6: Passive: +6 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Archmagi: This item grants the wearer +200 maximum spell points. Sorcerers and Favored Souls gain up to double spell points from items.

Elemental Absorption +5%: Passive: 5% Enhancement Bonus to Acid, Cold, Fire, and Electrical Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
Concentration +15: Passive: +15 Competence bonus to the Concentration skill.
Battle Arcanist: When all three items from the set are equipped, you will gain a 10% Enhancement discount to the Spell Point cost of all your spells.
